statusHistory.note: San Francisco Bay Area Tier 1 cluster, near-batch-30 run 2026-09-07-batch-30. IDENTITY CORRECTION carried over from prior session: this is a San Francisco venue, not Oakland — 4541 Irving St, Outer Sunset, San Francisco (est. 2017 by Kathryn Grantham, founder of NYC's Bluestockings). No Oakland location exists. Sourcing confirmed previously: official site blackbirdsf.com, SF Public Library community listing, Hoodline founding profile, goop, Time Out SF, SF Station, Yelp. No dedupe conflict per check-duplicates.mjs. Previously blocked because the only fetchable og:image was a small icon/logo, not a real storefront or interior photo. This session resolved the hero-image gate via near-illustrator's 'easy generic image' tier: a landscape, very recent (January 2026) street photo at 9th Ave and Irving St — the Outer Sunset corridor the bookstore is on, a few blocks east of its 4541 Irving St address — CC BY 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons, honestly captioned as not a venue photo. Coordinates are the venue's published street address geocoded against Google Maps' public listing for 4541 Irving St, San Francisco, CA 94122.
